name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Anders, Eklund, and Algae go with Cortex, Echo, and Forge, in some order.
Either Cortex goes with Plankton or Algae goes with Eklund.
Diatoms goes with Fontaine if and only if Forge goes with Algae.
Either Diatoms goes with Dasari or Plankton goes with Okafor.
Echo does not go with Geode if and only if Okafor goes with Geode.
Between Eklund and Drift, one goes with Fungus and the other with Geode.

hints.text: Suppose Anders went with Drift — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Anders goes with Drift.
Anders goes with Drift, so it can't also go with Cortex.
Anders goes with Drift, so it can't also go with Echo.
Anders goes with Drift, so it can't also go with Forge.
…but now the clue “Anders, Eklund, and Algae go with Cortex, Echo, and Forge, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Anders does not go with Drift.
